description: Proposed stable, redacted error taxonomy for exact-version registry_ref resolution. `current_code` is what crates/traverse-cli/src/main.rs emits today; every boundary collapses onto the single ApplicationManifestErrorCode::RegistryReferenceRequiresResolution, and the boundaries marked `current_check: none` are not evaluated at all. The successor implementation slice (#1272) MUST surface `proposed_code` per boundary with only `redacted_evidence_fields` in evidence.

boundaries.meaning: No synced public registry state, unreadable/parse-failed/schema-incompatible state, or no record for the requested namespace/id.
boundaries.next_slice_contract: Distinguish missing-sync from present-but-no-record; never emit the state file path.

boundaries.meaning: An exact `==x.y.z` range matches no synced version. Resolver MUST NOT fall back to a different version.
boundaries.next_slice_contract: Report requested_range and the set of available versions by identity only; keep fail-closed, no fallback.

boundaries.meaning: Selected version is not activatable. Today only the `deprecated` boolean is checked; `lifecycle` in {yanked, draft, inactive} is ignored.
boundaries.next_slice_contract: Gate on the record `lifecycle` field plus `deprecated`; report trust_lifecycle in evidence.

boundaries.meaning: Contract fetch failed at the transport/HTTP layer.
boundaries.next_slice_contract: Consume a prepared verified cache entry (spec 1258 FR-001); if a fetch layer remains, carry the HTTP status class and which asset failed, never the URL.

boundaries.meaning: Fetched contract bytes do not match `contract_digest` from the index.
boundaries.next_slice_contract: Report contract_digest (expected) only; the current message leaks `.traverse/cache/sha256/<digest>` and MUST be redacted.

boundaries.meaning: Artifact fetch failed at the transport/HTTP layer. Today indistinguishable from contract_retrieval: both emit the literal "registry asset download failed".
boundaries.next_slice_contract: Separate artifact from contract failures with distinct codes.

boundaries.meaning: Fetched artifact bytes do not match `digest` from the index.
boundaries.next_slice_contract: Report artifact_digest (expected) only; redact the cache path as above.

boundaries.meaning: The record's signature / trust bundle is missing or fails verification. Not checked anywhere in the CLI resolver today.
boundaries.next_slice_contract: Verify the signed bundle before the artifact is cached as activatable; report trust_lifecycle only.

boundaries.meaning: Artifact Host ABI major version is not supported by this Traverse build. Not checked in the resolver today.
boundaries.next_slice_contract: Compare against SUPPORTED_HOST_ABI_VERSION; report abi (both sides) only.

boundaries.meaning: The selected version's `permitted_targets` does not include the requested placement target. Not checked in the resolver today.
boundaries.next_slice_contract: Intersect record `permitted_targets` with the manifest placement target; report target and placement only.

boundaries.meaning: Verified bytes could not be committed to the content-addressed cache, or a different byte stream is already stored under the same digest key.
boundaries.next_slice_contract: Report the digest key only; keep the cache immutable and digest-keyed (spec 1258 FR-002).
